notes.title: Patch 1.13 Notes
notes.notes:
Patch 1.13 has just been released, which adds full controller support to the game and makes it compatible with Big Picture.

It has also added graphical improvements such as animation on the puzzle screen. In addition, the puzzle has a new help screen that explains it in greater detail.

Thank you for your support. If there is anything that doesn't work with the controller, or anything else that broke, then post on the forums and I will make sure it's fixed ASAP.

And for those who have beaten the game and enjoyed it, don't hesitate to leave a positive review. Even if short, it helps boost the game's visibility.

notes.title: Patch 1.12 Notes
notes.notes:
I've released a new patch that fixes a few glitches that were preventing players from getting two of the achievements.

I am hoping to implement Full Controller Support in the next patch so that the game will be compatible with Big Picture mode and Xbox 360 controllers, etc.
This will be available once the engine supports it.
